Clothing & appearance 2

Describe people's looks and clothing in Thai — height, build, hair, and dressing for the occasion. This second part covers appearance: สูง (tall), ตัวเล็ก (small-built), ผมยาว (long hair) and a fresh ตัดผม (haircut), through to compliments like หล่อ (handsome) and หน้าตาดี (good-looking). It covers dressing for the moment too — a sharp สูท (suit) for work, ชุดไทย (traditional Thai dress) for a wedding, and the modest แต่งกาย (dress) and ผ้าคลุมไหล่ (shawl) expected at a temple. All 33 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations, and word-by-word notes, so the descriptive vocabulary sinks in by ear.
